notes.title: A new update for Tomb Exploration VR!
notes.content:
A new update for Tomb Exploration VR has arrived!

- Fixed disappear of some special effects.

- The lamp lights have taken longer.

- The scene will be brighter.

- Added new animation for monster through physics simulation.

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.content:
Good news,We've just launched a major update!

We've been implemented support for the [b] Oculus Rift! ! ![/b]
And added a [b]bag system[/b],you can put items in bag now!

Added:
[list]
    [*]Oculus Rift support 
    [*]A bag system 
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
    [*]Reduced the value of the mouse's HP
    [*]Controller shaking loops in some scene
    [*]Readjust tools location
    [*]Increased the damage of the shovel
[/list]
